verdict.rationale: Weave provides a programmatic Evaluation API with Dataset objects and scoring functions (docs-6, docs-19, docs-25, docs-31), a Service API with REST endpoints for programmatic access to results (docs-15), and an official MCP server explicitly enabling coding agents to 'read live production data, run evaluations, and execute automatic iteration loops on their own' (docs-20, probe-4) — directly matching the agent-driven create-dataset/trigger-eval/read-results workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent autonomously completing this full loop end-to-end, and explicit example code showing dataset creation + eval trigger + result read-back in one flow.
